criteria.blocker: Three of the ten dimensions do not hold: scalable fanout (a measured 5x latency breach on the send route), realtime/notification delivery (4 of 6 declared chat notification events have no production dispatch site at all), and representative E2E (no functional chat seeded-e2e exists). criteria.clauses_failing: (A) SCALABLE FANOUT — MEASURED BREACH. contracts/benchmark-manifest.json requestLevel records `POST /chat/channels/{channelId}/messages@reference status=measured p95=5043.126ms` against declaredLatencyP95Ms=1000, and downstreamCalls=3 at the minority tenant against maxDownstreamCalls=0. This is what makes backend check:route-budgets-http exit 1 (/tmp/beg-check_route-budgets-http.log lines 7-8). CAVEAT recorded honestly: the capture's own provenance is `generatedAt 2026-09-03T16:10:03Z commit 2f37e1bb035006e5c03680497298ad62031e79d6 workingTreeDirty=true` — 4 commits behind head, i.e. BEFORE the fanout fixes (chat-messages.service.ts:210-218 now guards the member-row rewrite with isNotNull(archivedAt); chat-reply-reminders.service.ts:78-79 now batches). So the send route has NOT been re-measured at head and this clause is at best INCONCLUSIVE and at worst a 5x breach — never a pass either way. Separately, contracts/route-budgets.json still holds an older record for the same route reading `status: unmeasured, reason: route answered HTTP 500 — a non-2xx response measures the failure path, not the route`. (B) CACHE/REALTIME INVALIDATION — VERIFIED VIOLATION, and this confirms the finding the brief asked me to test. 4 of the 6 events declared in src/modules/notifications/notification-events-chat.catalog.ts have ZERO production dispatch sites: `chat.message.mention` (defaultPriority HIGH, defaultChannels IN_APP_PUSH_EMAIL), `chat.message.direct` (IN_APP_PUSH), `chat.thread.reply` (IN_APP_PUSH) and `chat.channel.invited` (IN_APP_EMAIL). Command: for each key, `grep -rn '"<key>"' src/ --include='*.ts' | grep -v '\.spec\.ts' | grep -v catalog` returns 0 hits; only chat.huddle.invite (chat-huddle-notifications.ts:65) and chat.reply.reminder (chat-reply-reminders.service.ts:250) are emitted. ChatNotificationsService.publishMentionNotification (src/modules/chat/chat-notifications.service.ts:109-163) only calls this.ably.publishToUser(..., 'notification:mention', ...) — an ephemeral realtime publish — and never reaches NotificationDispatchService. Net: a chat mention, a DM, a thread reply and a channel invite produce NO durable in-app notification, no email and no push; a user offline at send time never learns of them. (C) REPRESENTATIVE E2E — not met. There is no functional chat seeded-e2e. All 11 *.seeded-e2e-spec.ts files enumerated; only test/perf/route-budget-http.seeded-e2e-spec.ts mentions chat, and it is a latency/route-budget harness, not a behavioural test. src/modules/chat/chat.controller.e2e-spec.ts contains exactly one `it.each` asserting 401-without-a-token over 20 routes and nothing else. The three real-DB chat probes (chat-presence-conflict-target.db.spec.ts, chat-read-path-hardening.db.spec.ts, chat-send-conflict-target.db.spec.ts) are catalog/plan probes gated behind CHAT_DB_TESTS=1 and were not run here (no probe database). Nothing sends a message and reads it back across a page boundary, checks an unread transition, or proves a cross-tenant denial on a live row. (D) GATE THAT WOULD HAVE PROVED (B) CANNOT RUN — and its exit code is mis-coded. `verify:chat-mentions` is listed as exit 1 in GATE-STATUS.tsv, but /tmp/beg-verify_chat-mentions.log contains only the AUTH_SIGNING_KEYS preflight message, and src/scripts/verify-chat-mention-delivery.mjs:26-32 does `console.error(...); process.exit(1)` when AUTH_SIGNING_KEYS is unset (same shape at :22 for DB_URL and :34 for ABLY_API_KEY). That is a PREREQUISITE-ABSENT condition emitting exit 1 where the contract requires exit 2. The gate proves nothing in either direction and must not be read as a violation OR as evidence for (B) — (B) is proved by source, above. (E) MINOR, VERIFIED, NOT LOAD-BEARING: chat-mentions.ts:30-43 still expands @channel/@everyone/@here to the entire roster with no cap and an unlimited findMany (prior F18); chat-actions.controller.ts:33 still has no @Idempotent on create-task-from-message (prior F20), and check:idempotent-commands does not cover it (11 handlers in scope out of 547 controllers). Frontend check:route-bundle-budget reports /chat measuredScriptBytes=897897 > 524288 and measuredTotalBytes=1065625 > 1048576, but GATE-STATUS.tsv records that this measurement is knowingly stale and overstates /chat, so it is not counted as a violation here.
